title: Addressing the Feedback provider
description: How to write for a reader acting as Feedback provider. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `feedback-provider` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: The finding, then the evidence it rests on
rules.description: The finding, then the evidence it rests on. A finding that does not show what it read is an opinion, and the author is entitled to disagree with it on those terms.

source.quote: May be a program that cannot be argued with, or a reader with no context for why the artefact is as it is. Either way it knows one thing the adjudicator does not — what it actually looked at — and the process is worthless if that does not reach the lane below.
